description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndertim te ri buze rruges "Tom Plezha". Orientimi Jug, ne katin e 8 te ndertimit me ashensor. Siperfaqja totale eshte 77.5 m2 dhe organizohet si 1+1 me ballkon. Shitet sic eshte. Apartamenti ka certifikate pronesie.
description_en: The apartment is located in a new building on the edge of "Tom Plezha" street. Orientation South, on the 8th floor of the building with elevator. The total area is 77.5 m2 and it is organized as 1+1 with a balcony. Sold as is. The apartment has ownership certificates.
